newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T sets four-month high in active trade.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T sets four-month high in active trade.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc reached a four-month high in heavy trading on Thursday amid continued demerger hopes and as some investors sought out stocks which have recently lagged the rest of the market, traders said.
The stock was up 8p at 496-1/2 by 1347 GMT, after earlier reaching 500p, its highest since August. Volume reached 12.4 million shares, making it the third most active stock in the London market.
"Having been a poor performer, B.A.T is recovering and there is talk that some of the tobacco lawsuit fears have been overdone," said one trader.
"People are looking around for stocks that have underperformed," the trader said. B.A.T has languished for much of 1996, after reaching a year's high of 587p on January 26.

Earlier this week B.A.T said it was keeping an open mind about restructuring opportunities, as speculation that it was seeking a partner for its financial services businesses revived talk of a demerger of its insurance and tobacco arms.
The stock was also boosted this week by a sharp rise in U.S. tobacco group Philip Morris Cos, as Goldman Sachs raised its price target on the stock.
